items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think I met him once through Manny Albam but I was shy you know, and it was just in passing, I never really got to sit down and talk to Eddie.

ctx.x: Did you get to know Eddie at all?
Never got to know Eddie and I was always such an admirer of his, he was wonderful.
I did, I interviewed him for this program 15 years ago.
